script.title: Fake virus pop-up: 3 tricks and the 1 key combo that ends it
script.hook: 1 pop-up, 3 tricks, 0 real tech companies behind it.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: One pop-up, three tricks, and zero real tech companies behind it. Here's each trick, so you know it when you see it.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a laptop with a red full-screen warning No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Trick 1
segments.narration: Trick one: noise. An alarm sound, or a voice saying your computer is infected. It's meant to make you panic before you think.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a speaker icon with amber sound waves No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Trick 2
segments.narration: Trick two: it won't go away. It fills the screen, and the close button seems dead. It's just a web page in full-screen mode.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a browser window stretched edge to edge No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Trick 3
segments.narration: Trick three: a phone number. Call now, don't turn off your computer. Real tech companies don't put phone numbers in error messages.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a warning box with a phone number masked by dots No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Pause
segments.narration: Pause. What happens if you call? Someone friendly asks to connect to your computer to fix it. Then come fake scans, a bill for hundreds of dollars, and sometimes a fake refund that ends with them in your bank account.
segments.on_screen_text: Pause: what happens if you call?
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a full-screen countdown card reading PAUSE with a 3-second timer, then a cursor moving on its own No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The fix
segments.narration: So don't call. Close the browser. If it won't close, press control, alt, delete on Windows, or command, option, escape on a Mac, and force quit it. Or just restart.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. two keyboards with the key combos lit in teal No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Never
segments.narration: And never let anyone who contacted you install remote access on your computer. Already did? Disconnect from the internet and call your bank.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. the mascot blocking a cable plug No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.narration: On each site, you make an account, confirm who you are, and hit freeze. Some ask questions from your credit history, like an old address or a past loan. Save each login somewhere safe. You'll need it later.

segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a phone dialling a contact labelled Kid (old) No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Safe word
segments.narration: Even better, agree on a family safe word tonight. It takes two minutes, and it works for phone calls too.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a family group chat with a key emoji No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Already paid
segments.narration: Already paid? Call your bank or payment app right away, and report it at report fraud dot f t c dot gov.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a phone dialling a bank No text, no logos, no real people.

script.title: Quiz: 4 red flags in a $499 order email
script.hook: $499 for something you didn't buy. Find the 4 red flags before I do.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: Four ninety-nine for something you didn't buy. Find the four red flags in this email before I do. Here's the email, word for word.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. the quiz slide originality/out/quizzes/q3-invoice/slide-01.png No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The email
segments.narration: Thank you for your order of PC Security Plus, three years. Amount charged, four ninety-nine ninety-nine. Didn't authorize it? Call our cancellation desk within twenty-four hours. Pause here and count.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. the quiz slide q3-invoice/slide-01.png, zooming in No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Flags 1 and 2
segments.narration: Red flag one: the sender. A random address, not the company. Red flag two: a big charge you didn't make. It's there to panic you.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. quiz slides q3-invoice/slide-03 and slide-04 No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Flags 3 and 4
segments.narration: Red flag three: the twenty-four hour deadline. Red flag four: the phone number. It goes to a scammer who wants into your computer or your card, to 'refund' you.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. quiz slides q3-invoice/slide-05 and slide-06 No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The number
segments.narration: Email started about one in ten of the money-losing scams reported to the FTC in twenty twenty-five.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. the FTC chart originality/out/charts/c2-how-it-started.png No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The fix
segments.narration: So don't call the number in the email. Log into the real account, or check your card statement. No charge there means no charge. Mark the email as spam and delete it.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. the quiz slide q3-invoice/slide-07.png No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Close
segments.narration: How many did you get before I said them? Four out of four means you're ready for the next one.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. the mascot holding a score card No text, no logos, no real people.

script.title: Dating app to WhatsApp in 1 day: the pattern, hour by hour
script.hook: 1 day from match to 'let's move to WhatsApp.' Here's the pattern, hour by hour.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: One day from match to 'let's move to WhatsApp.' It happens fast, and it's on purpose. Here's the pattern, hour by hour.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a clock face with a heart and a chat bubble No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Morning
segments.narration: Morning: you match. They're warm, funny, and asking all the right questions. Afternoon: I barely use this app. Let's text on WhatsApp instead.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a dating app chat sliding to a private chat No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Why it matters
segments.narration: Here's why that matters. Dating apps can spot scam accounts and ban them, even mid-conversation. Private chat apps can't. Off the app, nobody's watching.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a lifeguard tower left behind on a beach No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The weeks after
segments.narration: Then the love-bombing speeds up. Good morning texts, big feelings, fast. And later comes the money: an emergency, a plane ticket, or an investment tip they swear by.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a heart turning into a coin No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The number
segments.narration: In FTC data for twenty twenty-five, people aged eighteen to twenty-nine were the most likely to have a money-losing scam start on social media. Forty percent did.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. the FTC chart originality/out/charts/c4-age-social.png No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Pause
segments.narration: Pause. Is moving apps proof of a scam? No. Plenty of real people prefer texting. It's a reason to slow down.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a full-screen countdown card reading PAUSE with a 3-second timer No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The fix
segments.narration: Keep chatting in the app until you've met on video or in person. If they keep pushing, report the profile, and never send money to someone you haven't met.
segments.on_screen_text: Stay in the app until you've met
